Contingency Fee Structure: Most reputable car accident lawyers in Georgia work on a contingency fee basis—meaning you pay no upfront or hourly fees, and they only collect a percentage (typically around 33.3%) if they recover money for you. John Foy & Associates +5
Trial Experience: While many cases settle out of court, insurance companies offer higher payouts when they know the lawyer is genuinely willing and able to take your case to trial. Simon Injury Lawyers +1
Insurance Defense Background: Lawyers who previously worked defending insurance companies (such as Chris Simon) often know the internal strategies insurers use to minimize payouts. Simon Injury Lawyers
